prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
**Robbins Construction** looks like a promising first call for a larger remodel: Houzz lists it at **5.0 stars from 21 reviews**, including a review describing a custom bathroom/utility remodel and prompt correction of issues. [Houzz’s Joplin contractor listings](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/general-contractor/joplin-mo-us-probr0-bo~t_11786~r_4392768)

For another option, **Pro Building Concepts** is listed at **5.0 stars from 8 Houzz reviews**, with reviewers praising communication and renovation work. [Houzz profile listings](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/general-contractor/joplin-mo-us-probr0-bo~t_11786~r_4392768)

For a repair or general-construction project, **GRC General Construction** is listed by the BBB as serving Joplin and holding an **A+ rating**; the listing gives **(417) 499-7424**. [BBB listing](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/category/remodel-contractors)

These are leads, not guarantees. Before hiring, get at least three written, itemized bids; ask for recent local references and proof of insurance; and confirm who will handle permits and subcontractors. BBB ratings and review-site scores are useful signals, but don’t replace checking references and contract terms.
